escenas.dice: Hi! I'm LeIA. This is ZANEI: a bodiless pilot against an invasion of geometric shapes.

escenas.voz: Seven weapons, bombs and four power levels. All drawn in neon lines.
Bosses break apart piece by piece: turrets, pods, spines… and finally, the core.
The story comes over the radio while you play, and it reacts to how you play.
Twelve levels, classical music turned into techno, in three languages.
Free at dailychallenge dot click, slash zanei. See you there!
